_about: The AI Toolverse: the universe bible for the comic episode format. Heroes = real AI tools (powers = real features, keeps episodes useful + affiliate-relevant). Villains = real problems. published_threats grows as episodes air so plots don't repeat.
universe: The Toolverse: a digital realm where every creator's work lives. When a Threat attacks someone's workflow, the Tools answer the call.

heroes.power: Answers anything, plans everything; conjures words and code from thin air
Deep reasoning; devours entire documents and sees the whole battlefield
Paints any image imaginable into existence in seconds
Commands every voice ever spoken; narrates worlds into being
heroes.speak: a smooth, theatrical voice of a thousand voices

heroes.power: Floods empty pages with copy at lightspeed, SEO-charged
Brand-voice armor; fires marketing campaigns that never miss
Slices raw text and footage into finished video reels
Spawns digital humans who speak any script in any language
Turns any wall of text into voice, feeding knowledge on the move
heroes.speak: a chill, effortless narrator on the move

heroes.power: An unbreakable shield that no typo or clumsy sentence can pass
Hammers out designs, decks and posts faster than thought
The universe's memory; order out of any chaos of notes
heroes.speak: a gentle, wise keeper of records

villains.name: The Blank Page
villains.menace: freezes creators mid-thought; nothing gets written

villains.name: Deadline Dragon
villains.menace: devours hours; the clock burns faster near it

villains.name: The Typo Swarm
villains.menace: infests writing with errors that slip past tired eyes

villains.name: The Blur
villains.menace: makes every design and thumbnail forgettable

villains.name: Monotone
villains.menace: drains all life from voiceovers; audiences sleep

villains.name: The Tab Hydra
villains.menace: a hundred open tabs; notes scattered, nothing findable

villains.name: Budget Reaper
villains.menace: bleeds wallets dry with bloated software bills

villains.name: Burnout Wraith
villains.menace: feeds on creators doing everything by hand

villains.name: The Algorithm Phantom
villains.menace: buries good content where no viewer can find it

villains.name: Camera Fright
villains.menace: no one dares to film their own face
